name: FREE SAMPLE · Multi-Source Lead Capture lite (from The Follow-Up Engine)

parameters.content:
## FREE SAMPLE · Multi-Source Lead Capture (lite)
One webhook takes leads from Typeform, Tally, Jotform, scheduling tools or any form that posts JSON, normalises them to name, email, phone, message and source, and writes them to a Google Sheet. A person who fills two forms stays one row (matched on email). No AI in this version.

Setup: Leads tab headers: date, name, email, phone, source, need, status, stage. Paste Sheet ID in Config, activate, and paste the webhook's Production URL into each form tool.

Credentials: pick or create your own Google Sheets OAuth2 credential. Nothing is hard-coded.

### Free sample from The Follow-Up Engine
The full version adds AI lead scoring, plus 6 more workflows: Speed-to-Lead Draft, Stage-Based Nurture, Reply Detector, Review & Referral Ask, Weekly Pipeline Report and Opt-Out Guard, with a 10-page guide.
